meta.description: Unique GS1 NPC scripts from GR-V1 .graal levels. Rebuilt 2026-10-21 by aggregating npc-library/<genre>/<topic>/book-NN/chapter-NN/page.json.
notes: Script bodies were removed from this repo on 2026-11-04 (copied text from the original levels). Each record keeps image, counts, source level names, events, commands and script_chars (original body length). The full bodies are kept outside the repo by the owner.
source_levels lists at most 3 file names per script (the page.json format caps it); count is the true occurrence count.
Scripts whose braces do not balance are flagged possibly_truncated; most end near 350-420 characters, a limit inherited from the original scrape.
events = event-flag names found in the script (substring match, so wasshot also matches wasshooted). commands = 2.05 command names found at statement start.
